## 

### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(forcats)
library(grid)
```

### Data import

```{r}
match_df <- read_csv(here("data", "proccesed", "perfect_matches_2_0.csv"))
protein_meta <- read_csv(here("data", "intermediate", "protein_metadata.csv"))

iedb_df <- read_csv(here("data", "intermediate", "wrangled_IEDB.csv"))
```

### Pathogen data inspection

```{r}
# =========================
# PREP DATA
# =========================

# Proteome counts per species
proteome_counts <- protein_meta |>
  group_by(Genus_species) |>
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Proteome_ID), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

# Sequence lengths per species
proteome_sizes <- protein_meta |>
  mutate(seq_len = nchar(Sequence)) |>
  group_by(Genus_species) |>
  summarise(cumulative_seq_len = sum(seq_len)) |>
  arrange(desc(cumulative_seq_len))

# =========================
# FIGURE A: Proteome counts
# =========================

p1 <- proteome_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Genus_species, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Number of proteomes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p2 <- proteome_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Number of proteomes per species",
       y = "Number of species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig_A <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# =========================
# FIGURE B: Proteome sizes
# =========================

p3 <- proteome_sizes |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Genus_species, cumulative_seq_len),
             y = cumulative_seq_len)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Total amino acids"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p4 <- proteome_sizes |>
  ggplot(aes(x = cumulative_seq_len)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Total amino acids per species",
       y = "Number of species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig_B <- p3 + p4 +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

# =========================
# SHOW
# =========================

fig_A
fig_B

rm(list = "p1", "p2", "p3", "p4", "fig_A", "fig_B",
   "proteome_counts", "proteome_sizes")
```

### Matches inspection (pathogen data)

```{r}
# Make summary data once
species_match_counts <- match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  group_by(Pathogen_Organism) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

# Plot A: top 15 species
p1 <- species_match_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Pathogen_Organism, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Number of matches"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Plot B: histogram of all species
p2 <- species_match_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Number of matches per species",
       y = "Number of species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Combine with patchwork
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

combined_plot

rm(list = c("species_match_counts", "p1", "p2", "combined_plot"))
```

### IEDB data inspection

```{r}
# Top 15 epitope source proteins by number of epitopes
iedb_df |>
  group_by(Protein_source) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Protein_source, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Epitopes per Source Protein",
    x = "Epitope source protein",
    y = "Number of epitopes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

# Histogram of epitope counts per source protein
iedb_df |>
  count(Protein_source, name = "n") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Epitopes per Source Protein",
    x = "Number of epitopes per source protein",
    y = "Number of source proteins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### matches inspection (IEDB data)

```{r}
# =========================
# PREP DATA
# =========================

protein_match_counts <- match_df |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(n))

# =========================
# PLOTS
# =========================

# Top 15 proteins
p1 <- protein_match_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Epitope_Source, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Epitope source protein)",
    y = "Number of matches"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Histogram
p2 <- protein_match_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Number of matches per source protein)",
    y = "Number of source proteins"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p3 <- match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  group_by(Assay_ID) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Number of matches per Epitope)",
    y = "Number of epitopes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# =========================
# COMBINE
# =========================

combined_plot <- p1 + p2 +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

combined_plot
p3

rm(list = "p1", "p2", "p3", "combined_plot")
```

### matched epitopes grouped by source protein and associated disease

```{r}
# Summary
assay_summary <- match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  count(Assay_ID, IEDB_Protein_ID, Disease, name = "n_matches") |>
  group_by(IEDB_Protein_ID, Disease) |>
  mutate(total_matches = sum(n_matches)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Protein_Disease = paste0(IEDB_Protein_ID, " (", Disease, ")"),
    Protein_Disease = fct_reorder(Protein_Disease, total_matches, .desc = TRUE)
  )

# Plot
p_all_assays <- ggplot(
  assay_summary,
  aes(
    x = n_matches,
    y = reorder(as.factor(Assay_ID), n_matches),
    fill = IEDB_Protein_ID
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(Protein_Disease ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = "log1p",
    breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
    labels = c("0", "1", "10", "100", "1000")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of matches (log scale)",
    y = "Epitopes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
  )

p_all_assays

rm(list = "assay_summary", "p_all_assays")
```

```{r}
# Prepare data
protein_epitope_summary <- match_df |>
  filter(Matched) |>
  count(IEDB_Protein_ID, Assay_ID, name = "n_matches") |>
  group_by(IEDB_Protein_ID) |>
  mutate(total_matches = sum(n_matches)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(total_matches))

a# Keep top proteins (important for readability)
top_proteins <- protein_epitope_summary |>
  distinct(IEDB_Protein_ID, total_matches) |>
  slice_max(total_matches, n = 10) |>
  pull(IEDB_Protein_ID)

plot_data <- protein_epitope_summary |>
  filter(IEDB_Protein_ID %in% top_proteins) |>
  mutate(IEDB_Protein_ID = fct_reorder(IEDB_Protein_ID, total_matches))

# Plot
p_fig3 <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = IEDB_Protein_ID,
    y = n_matches,
    fill = as.factor(Assay_ID)
  )
) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Epitope source protein",
    y = "Number of matches"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_fig3

rm(list = "protein_epitope_summary", "top_proteins", "plot_data")
```
